description: Resolve any combination of company name, domain, or LinkedIn URL into one canonical company identity: the name, primary domain, and LinkedIn company URL, each with a 0-100 confidence score plus an overall score and a match method. Cross-checks the inputs you give it, resolves the ones you do not, and flags conflicts (a domain and a LinkedIn slug that disagree) instead of merging them. A LinkedIn URL the actor finds is returned only when verified against the company site or the name, with the reason in linkedin_verification. Provide at least one of company_name, domain, or linkedin_url. Use this to reconcile or deduplicate records you already hold; use resolve_linkedin_url instead when you only need the LinkedIn company URL for a domain or name. Reads public data and writes nothing; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

company_name.description: Company name, e.g. Stripe. Provide at least one of company_name, domain, or linkedin_url.

domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com. The strongest canonical key when provided.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company URL (https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe) or bare slug (stripe).

max_charge_usd.description: Optional spending cap for this call, in USD, passed to the actor as max_charge_usd. The run stops before any charge that would take it past this amount and keeps every row already charged. Leave empty to rely only on the maximum charge per run set on your Apify account.

minLinkedinConfidence.description: A LinkedIn page the actor finds is returned only when its linkedin_confidence is at least this value, 0 to 100. Default "70". A LinkedIn URL you provide is always returned as given. Sent as a string for Clay compatibility.

skipCache.description: Force a fresh resolution and ignore the 7 day result cache.

name: resolve_company_identity
title: Resolve Company Identity
